Fixed. In `Option.__init__` (src/click/core.py), the auto-default `False` for flags was applied even when the option was declared `required=True`, so a required flag was never considered missing. Changed:

    if is_flag and default_is_missing and not self.required:
        self.default = False

Now `--flag` with `is_flag=True, required=True` and no default raises `Missing option '--flag'.` (exit code 2) when omitted, and works normally when given. Full test suite still passes: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed.
